title: Filing appeals with the State Commission

content.scenario: A consumer in India has received an order from the District Commission, and they want to appeal it to the State Commission. The consumer has prepared to file an appeal to the State Commission against the order of the District Commission.
content.outcome: The State Commission will consider the appeal and make a decision based on the facts and law.

user_queries: How to file an appeal to the State Commission?
What is the process for filing an appeal to the State Commission?
Can I appeal an order from the District Commission to the State Commission?
